Candidate_A_FPR_3pct.name: Candidate A (Strict Conservative: E5 FPR <= 3%)
Candidate_A_FPR_3pct.rationale: Matches E6-C production clean baseline false alarm rate (approx 2.97%).

Candidate_B_FPR_5pct.name: Candidate B (Moderate Trade-Off: E5 FPR <= 5%)
Candidate_B_FPR_5pct.rationale: Allows controlled false alarms on clean data up to 5% to boost recall.

Candidate_C_FPR_7.5pct.name: Candidate C (High-Sensitivity: E5 FPR <= 7.5%)
Candidate_C_FPR_7.5pct.rationale: High-sensitivity threshold for catching subtle AI generation.

Candidate_D_Max_F1.name: Candidate D (E5 Maximum F1-Score)
Candidate_D_Max_F1.rationale: Maximizes harmonic mean of precision and recall on clean validation.

Baseline_Standard_0.50.name: Standard Default Operating Point (0.50)
Baseline_Standard_0.50.rationale: Standard decision threshold for baseline comparison.
